purpose: development-session smoke test required before companion static production candidates are authoritatively promoted to production_export

required_checks.pass_when: all requested semantic keys resolve without raw filename coupling
layer anchors align and composition does not shift canonical face/body geometry
identity and critical expression cues remain readable

appearance profile replacement does not change companionId or expression/lighting semantics
same semantic expression and lighting request can switch companionId with no domain-code filename dependency

design_session_boundary: no Android/Kotlin implementation in design session
